job.title: Plastics Quality Inspector
job.description:
Plastics Quality Inspector

As a Plastic Quality Inspector, your primary responsibility is to ensure that plastic products meet specified quality standards before they are released for distribution or use. You will be tasked with examining plastic components, parts, or products to identify any defects or deviations from quality standards. Your role plays a crucial part in maintaining product integrity, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency within the manufacturing process.

Responsibilities

  • Inspection: Conduct thorough inspections of plastic products, components, or materials using various inspection techniques such as visual inspection, measurements, and testing procedures.

  • Quality Control: Implement quality control measures to ensure that plastic products meet established quality standards and specifications. This includes assessing factors such as dimensions, surface finish, color consistency, and structural integrity.

  • Defect Identification: Identify and document any defects, flaws, or irregularities in plastic products or materials. Determine the root causes of defects and work with relevant stakeholders to implement corrective actions.

  • Compliance: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and company policies related to product quality and safety.

  • Documentation: Maintain accurate records of inspection findings, test results, and quality control activities. Prepare inspection reports and documentation for internal records and regulatory purposes.

  • Communication: Collaborate with production personnel, quality assurance teams, and other stakeholders to communicate quality issues, provide feedback, and facilitate continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Problem-Solving: Investigate quality-related problems or issues encountered during the manufacturing process. Participate in problem-solving efforts to identify solutions and prevent recurrence of quality issues.

  • Calibration: Perform regular calibration and maintenance of inspection equipment and tools to ensure accurate and reliable measurements.

  • Training: Provide training and guidance to production workers or colleagues on quality standards, inspection techniques, and quality control procedures.

  • Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in continuous improvement activities aimed at enhancing product quality, process efficiency, and overall performance within the manufacturing environment.

Qualifications and Skills

  • High school diploma or equivalent; additional technical education or certification in quality control or related field is preferred.

  • Proven experience in quality inspection or quality control, preferably in a manufacturing environment, with a focus on plastic products or materials.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify defects or deviations from quality standards.

  • Familiarity with quality control tools and techniques, such as measurement instruments, gauges, and testing methods.

  • Good communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively communicate quality-related issues and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate quality issues, analyze root causes, and propose solutions.

  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and quality standards applicable to plastic manufacturing processes (e.g., ISO standards, ASTM specifications).

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and prioritize tasks effectively to meet production deadlines.

  • Proficiency in using computer software for documentation, record-keeping, and data analysis.
